title: TH17 cells contribute to uveitis and scleritis and are inhibited by IL-27/STAT1 in the retina. \(4) Confocal microscopy
protocol: Euthanize adult C57bl/6 mice by CO2.
Embed globes in cryomolds containing Tissue-Tek OCT compound and freeze on dry ice.
Cut frozen sections at 10 μm thickness with a Leica 3060S cryostat.
Collect sections on SuperFrost/Plus slides and store at -70°C.
Allow slides to air-dry under vacuum for 20 minutes prior to immunolabeling.
Fix sections in 4% formaldehyde in 1X PBS for 10 minutes.
Wash sections repeatedly in 1X PBS after fixation.
Block sections in 5% normal goat serum in immunolabeling buffer.
For paraffin-embedded sections, fix eyes in 10% Formalin overnight.
Embed globes in paraffin and cut 5 μm sections with a microtome for antibody staining.
Incubate sections in xylene for 3 minutes (repeat 3 times).
Incubate sections in 100% ethanol for 2 minutes (repeat twice).

Hydrate sections by placing slides in 95% ethanol for 2 minutes (repeat twice), then 70% ethanol for 2 minutes (repeat twice), and finally 50% ethanol for 2 minutes (repeat twice) and 30% ethanol for 2 minutes (repeat twice).
Transfer sections to distilled water.
Block sections with normal rabbit serum for 1 hour.
Dilute rabbit polyclonal antibody to IL-27 in immunolabeling buffer at concentrations of 5 μg/ml and 10 μg/ml (stock antibody = 500 ug/ml, working dilutions of 1:50 and 1:100).
Incubate sections in diluted primary antibody overnight at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Rinse sections in immunolabeling buffer three times.
Incubate in Alexa 568 conjugated goat anti-rabbit secondary antibody containing DAPI (1 μg/ml) for 1 hour at room temperature in an opaque chamber.
Wash sections in immunolabeling buffer (3 times).
Mount sections in anti-fading agent and cover with a coverslip.
Examine sections on a Leica SP2 laser scanning confocal microscope.
